accept_criteria: Every manifest segment has classification metadata (theme, type, or equivalent)
Theme labels map to content_brief topics or analysis_state themes
Segment ids in output match manifest without orphans
max_segments cap not silently dropping tail segments without decompose
reject_patterns: theme_unmapped on a material share of segments
Missing segments relative to manifest count after non-collate primary
Classifications contradict speaker roles or brief thesis
Truncation with incomplete segment batch coverage
